items.event: US Open women's final — Sabalenka vs Rybakina
items.line: Two-time defending champ Sabalenka chases a three-peat (first since Serena 2012-14); Rybakina, who beat her at the Australian Open, is the only other player who's had her number this year. Winner-take-all rematch of that AO final.

items.event: Solheim Cup — Sunday singles, USA vs Europe
items.line: Locked at 8-8 after Europe won the foursomes and the US stormed back in the four-balls behind Jennifer Kupcho. All 12 singles matches at Bernardus Golf decide it: defending champ USA need 6 points, Europe need 6.5 to reclaim the Cup.

items.event: Manchester derby — Man United vs Man City
items.line: First Manchester derby since 2016 without Guardiola on City's bench — new boss Enzo Maresca has City perfect through 3 (9 pts, top of the table) while United sit 11th after a rocky start. Old Trafford, title-race stakes early.

items.event: US Open men's final — Shelton vs Zverev
items.line: Ben Shelton's first Slam final at home in New York, having knocked out defending champ Alcaraz in the quarters, against top seed Zverev — fresh off his maiden major at Roland-Garros and leading their head-to-head 5-0.
